title: Alliance ALL19
description: Alliance's crypto accelerator. ALL19 starts on January 11, 2027: two weeks of in-person onboarding in New York City, an eight-week remote program, then Demo Day in New York City. Alliance invests $400K upon admission and $400K follow-on at seed.
reward: $400K upon admission + $400K follow-on at seed, at a $4M post-money valuation via SAFE with a 1:1 token side letter
setup: start the application with the first founder's email
rules: Regular Admission closes November 18; Early Admission closed on September 23. Alliance states no timezone, so EarnKit lists the end of November 18 UTC.
ALL19 starts on January 11, 2027: 2 weeks of in-person onboarding in New York City (weeks 1 and 2), an 8-week remote program (weeks 3 to 9) and Demo Day in New York City (week 10).
Deal: $400K upon admission and $400K follow-on at seed. Alliance invests at a $4M post-money valuation via SAFE with a 1:1 token side letter.
For technical founders building something ambitious; pre-product, pre-revenue and non-crypto-native startups are considered.
The application takes about 20 minutes. Mentors review it within 1 week; selected teams get a roughly 10-minute Zoom interview, and final decisions are emailed within 24 to 48 hours of it.
The program is free. Teams that aren't selected don't get personalized feedback.
